children: U.S. commercial bank's Q3 net income and EPS rose from prior quarter
Company's net interest margin increased to 4.38% in Q3
Non-interest expenses rose due to merger-related professional costs
Company did not provide specific guidance for future quarters or full-year results in its press release
LOAN GROWTH - Co said portfolio loans increased 1.6% from prior qtr and credit quality remained strong
DEPOSIT GROWTH - Co reported 3% increase in deposit balances, including higher non-interest bearing demand deposits and brokered funding
NON-INTEREST INCOME - Increase in non-interest income mainly due to recognition of prior year lost revenue and repayment of legal expenses
